title: Sample Desk (HCP sampling with quarterly reconciliation)
summary: Four roles including external HCP and field rep logins scoped to their own records, products with per-HCP quarterly limits, stock batches with release and expiry, territory allocations, a request lifecycle with rep endorsement and compliance exceptions, deliveries acknowledged by e-signature or OTP with a courier API, and a quarterly reconciliation with per-rep lines and three 360 pages.
